typography.notes: Avoid Inter/Roboto for headings. Use Outfit for a modern, geometric yet approachable medical feel. Use tight tracking (tracking-tight) for headings > 32px. Use Figtree for highly legible clinical data tables and body text.

visual_enhancers.animations: Use Framer Motion for page transitions, entrance animations, and staggering list items. Static = dead.

layouts.alignment: Always left-align dense clinical content and forms for better readability. Optical alignment over geometrical.

components.navigation: Sticky top with Crystal Glass effect (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70). Never use fully transparent backgrounds. Include Logo, Links, and Primary CTA.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary uses deep trust blue text-white. Include subtle hover lift (-translate-y-[2px]) and shadow.
components.forms: Use Shadcn JS components. inputs/selects should be rounded-xl, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0B3B60]/20. DO NOT use generic HTML forms.
components.charts: Shadcn charts (Recharts) with clean tooltips, no grid clutter, and accessible color palettes (Blue and Green variants).
components.icons: lucide-react (default) or @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone weight for premium medical feel).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text against backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements, form inputs, and key data points MUST have data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based). e.g., data-testid='predict-submit-button'

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js/jsx) for React components, DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
Do not center-align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned). Left-align for natural reading flow.
Do not use generic transitions like 'transition: all'. Explicitly animate transform/opacity.
Prediction Form Requirements: 7 inputs only (Glucose Level, Blood Pressure, Skin Thickness, Insulin, BMI, Diabetes Pedigree Function, Age). EXCLUDE 'Pregnancies'.
For the Admin Dashboard & Model Performance pages, use Recharts for visual metrics (ROC, Confusion Matrix, KPIs, Pie, Bar charts).
Include 'data-testid' on every form input, submit button, and primary nav link to ensure robust testing.
Ensure generous spacing (p-8 to p-12) within medical cards to prevent a cluttered 'AI slop' look.
Use sonner for all toast notifications (success/error states for predictions and contact form).
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism effects.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder text or dummy image URLs.
